alina: starting bring-up of vento21b (21B int4) on canary. hitting intermittent OOMs under mixed traffic where some requests request 400-600 tokens. stack points at prefetch and small contiguous slot gaps. anyone have heuristics that helped?

rob: saw similar with another 21b. our quick wins were: cap prefetch for long-gen, reduce microbatch when any long request in batch, and add compact-on-evict guarded by watermark.

vishal: data from the failing node:```
[2026-01-11T11:02:03Z] OOM: alloc 65536 bytes failed at slot_alloc.cpp:198
stack: slot::alloc -> prefetch_window::ensure -> runtime::handle_request
mem_used=62.7GB mem_limit=64GB free_chunks=35 largest_contig=0.75MB kv_slots=1602
```

tomo: largest_contig < page_size is the smoking gun. two safe mitigations: (1) per-model default max_new_tokens -> 300, (2) prefetch_budget cap -> 32 pages, skip prefetch if estimate_new_pages > prefetch_budget. both worked in quick repro.

alina: sounds reasonable. proposal for a 10% canary override:```{"model":"vento21b","defaults":{"max_new_tokens":"300","prefetch_budget":"32","microbatch_cap":"5"}}```
apply plus runtime flag compact_on_evict=true (evict_watermark=120).

rob: add an adaptive rule: if any request in batch requests > 350 OR estimated_new_pages>40, mark batch as long-gen and set microbatch_cap=3 and disable prefetch for that batch. keeps short gens fast.

vishal: i'll run quality eval (qa F1 + rouge-L) comparing default 300 vs 512 on our 60-sample set with fixed seeds and share diffs. also will run 200-run stability with mixed streaming to look for any residual OOMs.
